description: A top-down clip of a test bench on a station: six one-tile lanes side by side, each split by a firelock between a lower room and an upper area. The upper areas hold, from left to right: an exposed lattice open to space, dense purple gas, fire, fire (behind a glass firelock), purple gas (behind a thin edge firelock), and plain air (the last firelock starts open). The shut firelocks show coloured warning brackets. During the clip the last firelock shuts and purple gas is released above it, and later the second firelock is opened.
reproduces: https://github.com/space-wizards/space-station-14/issues/36889 (a firelock's warning light keeps showing once the door is open), plus the further firelock defects injected for this task.
scenario: A purpose-built firelock test bench on a fresh grid (walls, floor, lattice and wall lamps), recorded from the real game client: standard, glass and edge firelocks hold back space, dense gas and fire. Partway through, one open firelock is shut and gas is released behind it, and another firelock is opened while it is still holding back its gas.
